result: {"counter_case": "18 of the 24 timeouts (75%) came from the single integration job, whose fixture download grew from 1 GB to 4 GB. That points to a regression in one job, not a limit that is too low for CI generally. Raising the limit for every job to 45 minutes hides the regression and lets every job run 15 minutes longer before it is cancelled. Fixing or caching the fixture, or raising the limit only for integration, would remove most of the timeouts. The remaining 6 of 400 runs (1.5%) would not justify a global change. The request also never shows that 45 minutes is enough for the integration job, which may keep growing. In addition, a 95th percentile of 28 minutes does not fit 6% of runs being cancelled at 30 minutes.
